issues.title: Missing FAQ structured data on revenue pages
issues.summary: High-intent pages are not exposing answer-ready schema blocks for AI and snippet extraction.
evidence: FAQ schema absent on top landing pages
No question-answer blocks in crawl summary
issues.recommendation: Inject FAQ schema plus compact answer blocks tied to target queries.

issues.title: Brand entities are weak in AI-search summaries
issues.summary: The brand is not consistently represented with citation-friendly summaries, proof points, and direct claims.
evidence: Low mention clarity in mock AI visibility benchmark
issues.recommendation: Add entity summary sections, trust proof, and brand-specific answer passages.

issues.title: Internal linking depth is too shallow for priority commercial pages
issues.summary: Priority pages do not receive enough contextual internal links from supporting pages.
evidence: Only 2 supporting links into core page cluster
issues.recommendation: Create contextual internal links from supporting content to core pages with commercial intent anchors.

issues.title: Answer-engine passages are too long and not extractable
issues.summary: Pages have long blocks of content without concise answer-first formatting.
evidence: No direct-answer sections near H2 blocks
issues.recommendation: Rewrite primary answer passages into short answer-first blocks under matching headings.
